nodes.description: Authority contract controlling DSAuth access; can be replaced by owner.
Owner address of DSAuth, set to msg.sender at construction.
Owner address used by onlyOwner guards across admin contracts.
Admin address able to change owner via setOwnerByAdmin.
Mapping of addresses permitted when ALL_AUTHORIZED is false.
Global flag bypassing per-address authorization checks.
Currently active monitor contract allowed to call callExecute.
Pending monitor address set during a monitor change request.
Timestamp storing when a monitor change was requested.
Waiting period before a pending monitor change can be confirmed.
Per-user nonce mapping preventing EIP712 signature replay.
Mapping from code hash to deployed contract address used to cache created proxies.
Protocol fee wallet address receiving collected service fees.
Sets a new DSAuth owner, guarded by the auth modifier.
Owner-only function that selfdestructs the contract and sends remaining balance.
Owner-only withdrawal of stuck ETH or ERC20 tokens.
Owner-only grant/revoke of an authorized caller.
Owner-only toggle of the global ALL_AUTHORIZED flag.
Only-monitor function that executes arbitrary calldata on a user DSProxy and forwards leftover ETH.
Starts a monitor change request using the current block timestamp.
Confirms the pending monitor after CHANGE_PERIOD elapses, based on now.
Only-monitor execution of arbitrary calldata on a user DSProxy with ETH refund.
Confirms pending monitor change after time period, based on now.
Authorized function verifying an EIP712 signature and a nonce before executing arbitrary calldata through a DSProxy.
Deploys contract code with CREATE in assembly and caches the resulting address by code hash.
Computes and transfers the service fee, using tx.origin bot registry lookup and external token/ETH transfers to the fee wallet.
Computes gas cost reimbursement and transfers it to the fee wallet.
Public unguarded function transferring contract balance (ETH or ERC20) to an arbitrary user.
Reads the owner of the DSProxy context via proxy.owner().
Computes gas cost from tx.gasprice capped by MAX_GAS_PRICE.
Registers or updates a user subscription based on msg.sender.
Public payable sell entry that pulls fee then performs token exchange.
Public payable buy entry that pulls fee then performs token exchange.
Public unguarded borrow that transfers borrowed funds to msg.sender.
Public function giving DSProxy permission to an Aave import contract during a flash loan.
Public function initiating a dYdX flash loan and granting permission to an arbitrary receiver.
Public unguarded withdrawal of the contract's full token balance to the caller.
Internal function pulling DAI from the caller to join into the vat.
Repay entry that redeems collateral, swaps, pays the lending pool and forwards leftovers to tx.origin/user.
Boost entry that borrows, swaps and deposits collateral, forwarding leftovers to tx.origin/user.
Caller-controlled address used across access control checks and transfers.
Block timestamp used for time based monitor change gating.
Transaction origin used for bot registry fee logic and refund recipients.
selfdestruct invoked in AdminAuth.kill, destroying the contract and sending balance.
Native ETH/token transfer to a caller supplied or derived address.
tx.origin used to decide fee tier via BotRegistry, an authorization-like check.
ecrecover used to validate an EIP712 signature for arbitrary proxy execution.
now-based comparison controlling monitor change confirmation, timestamp dependent.
Low-level CREATE in assembly used to deploy arbitrary bytecode.
External call to DSProxy.execute with arbitrary target and calldata, potential reentrancy.
Address parameter for the new authorized admin in Auth.setAuthorized.
Address parameter for the proposed new monitor in changeMonitor.
User address parameter used in getFee to look up custom fees.
Amount parameter from which the fee is computed in getFee.
Token address parameter deciding ETH vs ERC20 fee transfer in getFee.
Local fee tier value derived from MANUAL/AUTOMATIC/custom fee logic.
Local computed fee amount returned by getFee.
EIP712 typed digest hashed for signature verification in callProxy.

edges.reason: tx.origin is read inside getFee to decide the automatic fee tier via BotRegistry.
msg.sender context influences fee wallet payout path in getFee.
_user parameter feeds the Discount custom fee lookup in getFee.
_amount parameter is divided to compute feeAmount, arithmetic dependency.
_tokenAddr parameter selects ETH transfer vs ERC20 safeTransfer.
fee local controls branching between manual/automatic/custom fee tiers.
feeAmount local is capped and returned from getFee.
getFee performs an external value transfer of the fee to WALLET_ADDR.
getFee relies on a tx.origin-based authorization check for bot fees.
kill checks msg.sender against owner before destroying.
owner state variable gates the kill function via onlyOwner.
kill executes selfdestruct sending balance to owner.
setAuthorized checks msg.sender against owner.
owner state variable gates setAuthorized.
_admin parameter is written into the authorized mapping.
changeMonitor is gated by the onlyAllowed modifier using msg.sender.
_newMonitor parameter is stored into newMonitor.
block timestamp (now) is recorded into changeRequestedTimestamp.
changeMonitor writes changeRequestedTimestamp used to gate later confirmation.
confirmNewMonitor compares now against changeRequestedTimestamp plus period.
changeRequestedTimestamp must be non-zero for confirmation to proceed.
newMonitor value is promoted to active monitor on confirmation.
CHANGE_PERIOD is added to the request timestamp for the time gate.
confirmNewMonitor overwrites the active monitor state variable.
callExecute is restricted to the monitor via msg.sender equality.
callProxy requires onlyAuthorized based on msg.sender.
digest local is computed and passed to ecrecover in callProxy.
callProxy uses ecrecover to validate the caller signature.
callProxy reads and writes the nonces mapping to prevent replay.
callProxy invokes DSProxy.execute on an arbitrary target with arbitrary calldata.
callExecute forwards value to DSProxy.execute, an external call enabling reentrancy.
callExecute returns leftover ETH to msg.sender.
subscribe uses msg.sender as the subscription key.
DSProxyCache.write is public and driven by caller supplied bytecode.
write uses assembly CREATE to deploy caller supplied code.
write stores the newly deployed address in the cache mapping.
AaveSaverProxy.repay refunds leftover ETH to tx.origin.
AaveSaverProxy.boost refunds leftover ETH to tx.origin.
sendContractBalance is public and unguarded, transferable by any msg.sender.
sendContractBalance performs ETH or ERC20 transfer to a supplied user.
BidProxy.withdrawToken is public and unguarded, sending balance to msg.sender.
withdrawToken transfers the whole token balance to the caller.
joinDai pulls DAI from msg.sender via transferFrom.
joinDai interacts with the vat through external join transfer.
MCDMonitorProxyV2.confirmNewMonitor compares now for the time gate.
MCDMonitorProxyV2.callExecute is restricted to the monitor via msg.sender.
callExecute performs an external DSProxy.execute call, reentrancy surface.
CompoundBorrowProxy.borrow is public and unguarded, called by any msg.sender.
borrow transfers the borrowed asset to msg.sender.
importLoan is public and grants proxy permission based on caller context.
importLoan triggers flash loan callbacks into arbitrarily configured contracts.
takeLoan is public and allows specifying an arbitrary receiver.
takeLoan gives DSProxy permission to an arbitrary receiver contract during the loan callback.
calcGasCost helper used by monitor functions whose refunds go to tx.origin.
getUserAddress derives the DSProxy owner in the current call context.
SaverExchange.sell is a public payable entry keyed on msg.sender for fees.
SaverExchange.buy is a public payable entry keyed on msg.sender for fees.
sell transfers fee and leftovers via sendLeftover to the user.
buy transfers fee and leftovers via sendLeftover to the user.
setOwner uses the auth modifier which reads msg.sender via isAuthorized.
getGasCost transfers the gas reimbursement based on caller context.
getGasCost performs external ETH or ERC20 transfer to the fee wallet.
withdrawStuckFunds is owner gated using msg.sender.
withdrawStuckFunds transfers stuck ETH or tokens to owner.
setAllAuthorized is owner gated using msg.sender.
AaveSaverProxy.boost sends leftovers based on the derived user and tx.origin.
AaveSaverProxy.repay sends leftovers based on the derived user and tx.origin.

normalization_plan.reason: The _admin parameter is only consumed to write the authorized mapping inside setAuthorized.
The _newMonitor parameter is only used to populate newMonitor within changeMonitor.
The _user parameter is only read for the custom fee lookup inside getFee.
The _amount parameter is only used for fee division inside getFee.
The _tokenAddr parameter only selects the transfer branch inside getFee.
The fee local variable is computed and consumed entirely within getFee.
The feeAmount local is the internal result value of getFee.
The digest local is built and consumed solely for ecrecover inside callProxy.
